title: Your First Weekend at Bradley University, Shared as Cards
description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Meet at the Lydia Moss Bradley Statue
cards.subtitle: Founder's Circle at Bradley Hall
cards.notes: Start your weekend at the bronze statue of the university founder. It is a central campus landmark and a popular spot for first-year class photos.
cards.short_summary: A central campus landmark featuring the statue of university founder Lydia Moss Bradley.
cards.evidence_claim: The bronze Lydia Moss Bradley statue has graced the university's Founder's Circle since 1997 and is a site for orientation and class photos.
cards.source_title: Lydia is back - The Bradley Scout
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 as a public outdoor space on campus.

cards.title: Lunch at the Student Center
cards.subtitle: Michel Student Center
cards.notes: Grab a meal at the Marketplace Deli or Chick-fil-A. This hub is the go-to for reliable dining options and meeting up with new hall mates.
cards.short_summary: The primary student hub for dining, featuring a food court and student organization offices.
cards.evidence_claim: The Michel Student Center is the place to go for reliable dining options like Marketplace Deli and Chick-fil-A, accessible via meal plans.
cards.source_title: Looking For A Bite To Eat On Campus? - Lydia's Lounge
cards.access_notes: Open daily; weekend hours typically 11 a.m. to midnight.

cards.title: Join the Welcome Bash
cards.subtitle: Alumni Quad
cards.notes: Head to the quad for the annual Welcome Bash. It is a prime opportunity to meet other students and engage with campus faculty in a relaxed setting.
cards.short_summary: A large outdoor green space that hosts major Welcome Week events and student gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Welcome Bash is held on the Alumni Quad during Welcome Week to help students connect and build friendships.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor event; specific times vary by year but typically midday on Sunday.

cards.title: Explore the Rec Center
cards.subtitle: Markin Center
cards.notes: Check out the 46-foot rock climbing wall or the indoor pool. It is the center for intramurals and late-night student activities.
cards.short_summary: A 130,000-square-foot facility featuring a climbing wall, pool, and basketball courts.
cards.evidence_claim: The Markin Center features a 46-foot rock climbing wall, indoor pool, and four basketball courts, and hosts Late Night BU events.
cards.access_notes: Weekend hours are typically 12 p.m. to 7 p.m. during the academic year.

cards.title: Find Your Study Spot
cards.subtitle: Cullom-Davis Library
cards.notes: Visit the library to scout out the quiet basement for solo study or the first floor for group work. You can also pick up your Bradley ID here.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library offering three floors of varied study environments and IT support.
cards.evidence_claim: Cullom-Davis Library offers three floors of seating and is the location for QuickCard (ID) pick-up during move-in weekend.
cards.access_notes: Open 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. on move-in Saturday; regular late hours until midnight.

cards.title: Sample the Taste of Bradley
cards.subtitle: Olin Quad
cards.notes: Visit this annual event where local food trucks park in the quad. It is a great way to sample Peoria's local flavors without leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: An annual Welcome Week event featuring local food trucks on the Olin Quad.
cards.evidence_claim: Taste of Bradley is an annual event where local food trucks park in the quad and offer specialties to students.
cards.access_notes: Typically held Sunday evening from 5 p.m. to 7 p.m. during Welcome Week.

cards.title: Attend a Guest Speaker Session
cards.subtitle: Renaissance Coliseum
cards.notes: Visit this multi-use athletic facility for first-weekend guest speakers or to tour the athletics museum in Burklund Family Heritage Hall.
cards.short_summary: A 165,200-square-foot athletic venue and home to the university's athletics hall of fame.
cards.evidence_claim: Renaissance Coliseum hosts Welcome Week guest speakers and includes the Burklund Family Heritage Hall athletics museum.
cards.access_notes: Open for scheduled events; museum hours typically Monday-Friday 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.

cards.title: Explore Campus History
cards.subtitle: Shaheen Hall of Pride
cards.notes: Walk through the Shaheen Hall of Pride to see 22 display cases and dioramas chronicling Bradley's growth since 1897.
cards.short_summary: A Collegiate Gothic building featuring a museum-style hall dedicated to university history.
cards.evidence_claim: The Shaheen Hall of Pride in the Hayden-Clark Alumni Center features 22 display cases and dioramas chronicling the university's history.
cards.access_notes: Open 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. on move-in Saturday; regular hours vary.

cards.title: Visit the Historic Clock School
cards.subtitle: Westlake Hall Atrium
cards.notes: See the renovated interior of one of Bradley's original buildings. Once a school of horology, it now features a modern six-story atrium.
cards.short_summary: One of the university's two original buildings, now featuring a modern collaborative atrium.
cards.evidence_claim: Westlake Hall is one of the two original buildings on campus, originally home to the School of Horology, and was renovated to include a new center atrium.
cards.access_notes: Academic building; accessible during standard university hours.

cards.title: Walk the Fredonia Block Party
cards.subtitle: Fredonia Avenue
cards.notes: Stroll down Fredonia Avenue during the Welcome Week block party to learn about student organizations and Greek life on campus.
cards.short_summary: A street adjacent to campus that hosts a major annual block party for new students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Block Party on Fredonia is a Welcome Week event where students can get an up-close look at Greek Life and student organizations.
cards.access_notes: Typically held Monday afternoon from 4 p.m. to 6 p.m. during Welcome Week.
